digest.component_or_area: binding recovery and retirement completion at reconcile boundary
propositions: A crash after retired tombstone replacement but before live replacement leaves the same identity in both states, creating a detectable and safely completable partial state that cannot be repaired at construction or preview time.

Incomplete-operation recovery must be invoked once at the validated write-bearing boundary in reconcile.py, after staleness validation and before the first remote fetch, to prevent interleaving new liveness evidence with completion.
Recovery requires exact agreement between tombstone, forward entry, and reverse entry identities; mismatch triggers a typed safety abort and leaves recoverable evidence with zero mutation.

Tombstone is the authoritative retirement intent; automatic signals (200 response, clear_absent, same-key confirm) do not revoke it, only explicit unretire removes the tombstone and prevents completion.
The production rich-text handler must be cut from mutating bindings through all_bindings() and use the narrow facade operation instead.
Construction, load, reconcile-check, dry-run, preview, selection, and filtered runs must perform zero writes from the retirement-completion operation.
